title: Ethiopian Chicken Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew made with chicken, alicha spice blend and local ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and carrots to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the kik, alica spice blend, and zesty to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over fettuccine noodles, garnished with chopped fresh herbs.
